What is written: your finished sessions (strength training, start, end, name) and your body weight, one entry per day (your weigh-in, otherwise the weight entered when starting your last session of the day).
When: when you finish, edit or delete a session, when you add or delete a weigh-in, and when you tap “Send history”.
Nothing else: MuscleNote reads no data from Health Connect and sends nothing over the internet; your data stays on your phone.
To stop: turn off the Health Connect switch in Settings. Data already written can be deleted from Health Connect\'s settings.

Raises, squeezes and lowers the shoulder blades: it carries heavy loads and holds the upper back in rows.
Raises the arm in front of you: it pushes in every press, especially overhead.
Lifts the arm out to the side: it gives the shoulders their width, trained by lateral raises.
Pulls the arm back: it helps in rows and pulldowns and balances the shoulder against the chest.
Brings the arm across the body and pushes it forward: it drives presses, dips and push-ups.
Bends the elbow and turns the palm up: it drives curls and helps in pull-ups and rows.
Straightens the elbow: it finishes every press and dip and makes up two thirds of the upper arm.
Close the hand and hold the wrist: they are your grip, working whenever you hold something heavy.
Curls the trunk by bringing the ribs toward the pelvis, and braces the core under heavy loads.
Rotate and bend the trunk, and keep it upright when the load is on one side.
Pulls the arm down and back: it drives pull-ups, pulldowns and rows.
Straighten the spine and keep it upright: they work in deadlifts, squats and rows.
Extend the hip and move the leg outward: they drive squats, lunges and deadlifts.
Straightens the knee: it drives squats, the leg press and leg extensions.
Bend the knee and extend the hip: leg curls and deadlifts.
Bring the leg inward: they steady the knees in squats and lunges.
Point the foot, heel up: standing works mostly the gastrocnemius, seated mostly the soleus.
